text.tspan: Per capita plastic waste vs. GDP per capita 2010
Per capita plastic waste generation rate is measured in kilograms per person per day. GDP per capita is adjusted
for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Per capita plastic waste (kilograms per person per day)

tspan.tspan: Jambeck, et al. (2015); Data compiled from multiple sources by World Bank (2025)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2010 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
